title: wish / if only / I'd rather / it's time
recall: wish + past, wish + had V3 va wish + would farqi nima? I'd rather va it's time qanday ishlatiladi?
formula: wish / if only + past: hozirgi holatdan norozilik — I wish I had more time
wish + had V3: o'tmishdagi afsus — I wish I hadn't said that; wish + would: boshqaning xatti-harakati — I wish you would stop
I'd rather (you) + past / I'd rather do; It's (high) time we + past / to do

items.uz: Qani endi ko'proq vaqtim bo'lsa.
en: I wish I had more time.
If only I had more time.

items.uz: Qani endi u gapni aytmagan bo'lsam.
en: I wish I hadn't said that.
If only I hadn't said that.

items.uz: Qani endi sen shovqin qilmasang. (jahl bilan)
en: I wish you would stop making noise.
I wish you wouldn't make so much noise.
I wish you'd stop making noise.

items.uz: Qani endi ingliz tilini yaxshi bilsam.
en: I wish I spoke English well.
I wish I knew English well.
I wish my English were better.

items.uz: Qani endi o'sha kuni u yerda bo'lsam edi.
en: I wish I had been there that day.
If only I had been there that day.

items.uz: Men uyda qolishni afzal ko'raman.
en: I'd rather stay at home.
I would rather stay at home.
I'd rather stay home.

items.uz: Men sen bu haqda hech kimga aytmasligingni xohlardim.
en: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about it.
I would rather you didn't tell anyone.

items.uz: Ketish vaqti keldi.
en: It's time to go.
It's time we left.
It's time for us to go.

items.uz: Sen allaqachon ish topishing vaqti keldi.
en: It's high time you found a job.
It's time you found a job.

items.uz: Qani endi bu yerda dengiz bo'lsa.
en: I wish there was a sea here.
I wish there were a sea here.
If only there was a sea here.

items.uz: Qani endi ertaroq turganimda.
en: I wish I had got up earlier.
If only I had got up earlier.
I wish I'd woken up earlier.

items.uz: Qani endi yomg'ir to'xtasa.
en: I wish it would stop raining.
If only it would stop raining.

items.uz: Men taksi emas, avtobusda borishni afzal ko'raman.
en: I'd rather take the bus than a taxi.
I would rather go by bus than by taxi.

items.uz: Qani endi men ham siz bilan bora olsam.
en: I wish I could come with you.
If only I could go with you.

items.uz: Qani endi men o'sha mashinani sotib olmagan bo'lsam.
en: I wish I hadn't bought that car.
If only I hadn't bought that car.

items.uz: Sen mendan qolishimni xohlaysanmi yoki ketishimni?
en: Would you rather I stayed or left?
Would you rather I stay or go?

items.uz: Qani endi u menga qo'ng'iroq qilsa.
en: I wish he would call me.
If only he would call me.

items.uz: Endi o'zgarish vaqti keldi.
en: It's time for a change.
It's time to change.

items.uz: Qani endi men uni oldinroq uchratgan bo'lsam.
en: I wish I had met her earlier.
If only I had met her earlier.

items.uz: Qani endi u yerda bo'lmasam.
en: I wish I weren't here.
I wish I wasn't here.
If only I weren't here.

speak: Atrofingizdagi odamlar haqida 2 ta 'I wish you would…'
